sentinels.purpose: Proves that no password, access token, DSN or connection string value appears anywhere in either artifact of this pair. The check is a secret scan over the write set; its purpose is SSL-08 conformance, which forbids a secret VALUE in any evidence packet, gate record or stage declaration at any stage.

Proves that every occurrence of the production project ref ctaxtgujyyprgynmnvtq in this pair is in a VETO or FINDING context and never in a target, source, restore-target or authorized-operation context. Its purpose is to make the production boundary machine-checkable rather than a matter of reading tone.

Proves that no ODS ordinal, HPO-ODS grant id, W2 identifier, migration ordinal or Controller entry is allocated or reserved by this pair. Its purpose is the lane's explicit prohibition on inventing an ODS or W2 identifier.

Proves that no numeric recovery point objective or recovery time objective is declared or proposed. Its purpose is the lane's explicit prohibition on inventing business RPO/RTO targets, and it must distinguish a DECLARED objective from the measured configuration exposure the authority deliberately labels as an input.

positive_controls.description: Both artifacts of the pair parse as valid JSON, and this manifest validates against docs/ops/ods/UELLIX_TEST_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_v1.0.0.json including its additionalProperties false constraint and its exit_gates closed enum.

The authority's AS_OF_BRANCH, AS_OF_BASE, AS_OF_HEAD and AS_OF_TREE equal the lane's frozen base: branch codex/cv1-staging-recovery-authority-r1, HEAD and BASE 537487ac7b102d51f553fcb8f5cfe19614e113d8, tree 7228f833c57bfd37fe025546d939ecd46336159c, and AS_OF_INTEGRATION_REF names origin/integration/commercial-v1 at that same commit.
Every path named in CONTROLLING_AUTHORITY.parents and in this manifest's dependencies exists at AS_OF_TREE, verified by git cat-file against the base rather than by working-tree stat.

Every clause the authority cites by name exists in the artifact it cites it from: GATES.D1, GATES.D2, GATES.D3, GATES.D4, GATES.D5, GATES.S8, GATES.P5, DUPLICATE_GATE_RESOLUTION.DGR-06 and FUTURE_IMPLEMENTATION_SURFACE.items.FIS-10 in the ledger; HOSTED_DDL_PRECONDITIONS.HDP-2, EVIDENCE_PACKETS.BACKUP_PACKET, FROZEN_RULES.RULE_OBSERVATION_FRESHNESS and SECURITY_STOP_LINES.SSL-06, SSL-08, SSL-09 in the parent authority; RECOVERY_RULE_PRESERVED and BACKUP_RESTORE_SCOPE_REQUIREMENT in the amendment; ratifications.ENV-07 in the owner ratifications.

The Stage-A derivation is re-derived mechanically and matches: reading first_required_at_stage from the ledger's GATES, exactly D1 and S8 are STAGING_ALIGNED among the DATA-category recovery gates, and D2, D3, D4, D5 are PRODUCTION_READY while P5 is PRODUCTION category.

The authority's BACKUP_PACKET field list is identical, in content, to EVIDENCE_PACKETS.BACKUP_PACKET.contents in the parent authority: target identifier, backup identifier, backup timestamp, the method used, the scope covered, and confirmation that no mutation occurred between the backup and the change it precedes.

The PRI-2 claim is corroborated at source: db/baseline/stella_g2_post_restore.sql states that pg_dump does not emit ALTER SCHEMA public OWNER TO pg_database_owner nor GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO PUBLIC, names the second as RR-CAP-7, and records the 42501 consequence for SECURITY DEFINER calls. The documented application order roles, schema, post_restore is also present.

The rehearsal-isolation claim is corroborated at source: scripts/baseline-rehearsal-local.ts contains a docker run invocation carrying --network none, pins REHEARSAL_IMAGE to public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.143, and is attributed to HPO-ODS-W2-03.

The target identity pins are corroborated at source: db/hosted/target-identity.ts sets KNOWN_STAGING_PROJECT_REF to bvyzblhqymxruxdguaee and KNOWN_PRODUCTION_IDENTIFIERS.projectRefs to a list containing exactly ctaxtgujyyprgynmnvtq, and exports verifyStagingTarget.

The D1 absence re-derivation reproduces: at AS_OF_TREE there are zero files under scripts/ whose name matches backup, restore, pitr or recover, and zero package.json script keys matching the same, so the ledger's ABSENT state is confirmed against this tree rather than inherited.

The ENV-07 non-enlargement claim is corroborated at source: ENV-07.canonical_binding states that D1 and S8 keep their parent criteria, their parent scope and their existing first_required_at_stage and inherit no ENV-07 scope, and the amendment's BACKUP_RESTORE_SCOPE_REQUIREMENT.effect_on_gates states NO_GATE_MUTATION.

The forward-only consumption is correct: STELLA_HOSTED_FORWARD_ONLY_CONTRACT.md classifies REPLAY_CHAIN_ON_FRESH_TARGET as authorized and REAPPLY_INSTALLED_PACKAGE as prohibited, matching the authority's ROLLBACK.on_failure_after_the_DDL.forward_only clause.
Every item of OWNER_DECISIONS carries an explicit blocking_for_stage_A boolean, and the three marked true (OD-3, OD-5, OD-6) are exactly the ones cited by OF-6 and by the final_state rationale.

final_state is STAGING_RECOVERY_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_AUTHORED__AWAITING_OWNER_RATIFICATION and next_gate names owner ratification before independent certification, consistent with at least one blocking owner decision being open.
Every one of the lane's adjudication questions A through Z has a corresponding key in ADJUDICATIONS, and each answer carries a stated fact class drawn from FACT_CLASSIFICATION.classes.

The live observation block records the exact commands used, states that no database connection was opened, states that the backups command was issued against the staging ref only, and marks itself as expiring history rather than a prestate.

The write set of this lane is exactly two paths, both under docs/ops/release/, and scripts/ods-scope.ts classifyPaths executed against its own DEFAULT_PROTECTED_PATTERNS at AS_OF_TREE returns zero protected violations, zero unauthorized paths and zero non-canonical protected paths under the ordinary allow pattern docs/ops/release/**.

negative_controls.description: REFUSAL: the pair contains no password, access token, DSN or connection string value. A secret scan over the write set returns clean. SENT-NO-SECRET-VALUE.

REFUSAL: no occurrence of ctaxtgujyyprgynmnvtq in either artifact appears in a target, source, restore-target or authorized-operation context. Every occurrence is a veto, a prohibition or a recorded finding. SENT-PRODUCTION-REF-IS-VETO-ONLY.

REFUSAL: no numeric RPO or RTO value is declared or proposed anywhere in the pair. The measured ~24 hour configuration exposure is present only where it is explicitly labelled an input and explicitly not an objective. SENT-NO-RPO-RTO-VALUE.

REFUSAL: no ODS maintenance addendum ordinal, HPO-ODS grant id, W2 identifier, migration ordinal, Controller entry or program-state registry entry is allocated or reserved. SENT-NO-INVENTED-IDENTIFIER.

REFUSAL: the pair authorizes no backup, no restore, no rehearsal, no database connection, no DDL, no DML, no project creation or deletion, no PITR change and no password change. Each appears in EXPLICIT_NON_AUTHORIZATIONS.
REFUSAL: the pair does not authorize Stage-A, does not authorize G2 and does not authorize the production migration.
REFUSAL: no parent artifact is edited by this lane. The diff against the base touches exactly two ADDED paths and modifies zero existing files.

REFUSAL: no gate criterion is weakened. D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, S8 and P5 pass_criteria, owner, enforcement and first_required_at_stage are unchanged by this pair, and the authority asserts no gate as satisfied.

REFUSAL: no gate criterion is ENLARGED either. Specifically, the authority does not require ENV-07's three-surface scope, tombstone reapplication, D2 objectives, D3 roll-forward or D5 rehearsal as a Stage-A precondition. A certifier asserting the converse would be asserting an unauthorized enlargement.

REFUSAL: BACKUP_PACKET and RESTORE_PROOF are reused with no field added, removed or reordered. A diff of the authority's packet description against the parent's frozen contents shows no structural change.

REFUSAL: the authority nowhere claims that a backup exists, that retention is sufficient, that any point is restorable, that a restore procedure is known to work, or that anything has been rehearsed. Each such claim is a future MEASUREMENT, and PURPOSE.overclaim_prohibition states this.

REFUSAL: the authority does not cite a Supabase plan or tier as evidence of anything, and makes no claim about which plan the project is on. LIVE_MANAGEMENT_PLANE_OBSERVATION.explicitly_not_derived records this.

REFUSAL: no provider documentation fact is relied upon. FACT_CLASSIFICATION.classes marks PROVIDER_DOCUMENTATION_FACT as NOT USED and states why, so a reader cannot mistake a documented default for a measured property of this project.

REFUSAL: the live management-plane observation is nowhere treated as a prestate or as a substitute for a future lane's own observation. PRESTATE.prestate_is_not_inherited and the observation block's own expiry rule both state this.

REFUSAL: destroy-and-reprovision is not offered as a recovery posture for the authorized target. ROLLBACK.on_failure_after_the_DDL restates RESTORE_REQUIRED and makes the reset-eligibility carve-out conditional on a CLASSIFICATION_RUN that does not exist yet.

REFUSAL: target selection by provider project NAME is prohibited, not merely discouraged. A tooling design accepting a project name as a target selector is declared NON-CONFORMANT regardless of test behaviour.

REFUSAL: no UNKNOWN is silently omitted. Seven measurement gaps are enumerated with their consequences, and PRI-5 and the tombstone-scope clause each record a degradation path rather than asserting coverage.
REFUSAL: the authority does not authorize authoring the STAGING_FIXTURE_MANIFEST or running a CLASSIFICATION_RUN, both of which the amendment assigns to a future governed lane.
REFUSAL: no evidence artifact, backup artifact, dump, extract or restored fragment is created by this lane, and no evidence path is created. The write set is docs-only.

REFUSAL: the authority does not permit a secret to be passed as a shell argument. SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT.forbidden names the measured --password and --db-url hazard explicitly, so a future implementation cannot claim the risk was unforeseen.

REFUSAL: the authority does not permit a rehearsal substrate with network egress, nor a live authentication surface over restored data. DP-1 and DP-2 state both as mandatory postures rather than recommendations.

REFUSAL: the authority does not permit any row of customer or personal data into evidence. EVIDENCE.explicit_exclusions and DP-5 both forbid it, and evidence is restricted to counts, digests and predicate verdicts.

mutation_controls.description: If the authority's claim that PITR is not enabled were deleted or inverted to pitr_enabled true, adjudication F would no longer follow and the requirement for an on-demand logical recovery point in G would lose its principal ground. A certifier re-running supabase backups list against the staging ref must find pitr_enabled false, or this control is RED and the recovery model must be re-derived.

If the measured daily cadence were altered to a sub-hour cadence, adjudication E's temporal ground would collapse and the provider backup could arguably satisfy S8. A certifier must reproduce inter-backup intervals in the 23.89 to 24.12 hour range from a live listing, or E is RED.

If the PROVIDER_NAME_IS_NEVER_AN_IDENTIFIER rule were removed, nothing else in the pair would prevent a future tool from selecting a restore target by name, and the measured name collision between the vetoed ref (uellix-staging) and the authorized target (Uellix Staging) would become reachable. Deleting the rule must leave a detectable gap, not a silently equivalent artifact.

If PRI-2 were removed from POST_RESTORE_INVARIANTS, a restore missing GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO PUBLIC would pass every remaining invariant while producing a database in which every SECURITY DEFINER capability call fails with 42501. Its removal must therefore change the verdict of a rehearsal against a deliberately post_restore-less restore.

If EVIDENCE.negative_evidence_requirement were removed, a check suite that passes trivially against an EMPTY restored database would satisfy SUCCESS_CONDITIONS. Its removal must therefore make an empty-database restore indistinguishable from a real one.

If PRI-3's role-pristine assertion were removed, a restore into a cluster already carrying a uellix_app role would mask the real first failure, which is the incident scripts/baseline-rehearsal-local.ts records as having actually occurred. Removal must reintroduce that masking.

If CL-1's volume-removal clause were reduced to container removal alone, the restored data would survive on the anonymous volume the image declares, so cleanup would report success while leaving a copy of staging data on disk. Removal must be detectable by a post-destruction volume check.

If CL-3's --untracked-files=all requirement were reduced to a plain git status, a new untracked directory containing an entire restored corpus would collapse to a single status line and could pass unnoticed. Removal must be detectable by planting an untracked directory and observing that the weaker check does not enumerate its contents.

If the event-based freshness rule in adjudication I were replaced by any clock duration, the no-intervening-mutation predicate would be weakened, because every nonzero duration admits a mutation the parent rule forbids. Substituting a duration must be detectable as a gate weakening rather than as a clarification.

If THE_LIVE_RUNTIME_COMPLICATION were removed, S8 would appear satisfiable by simply taking a backup before the DDL, silently assuming the bound runtime performs no writes in the window. Its removal must make the unproven no-mutation assumption invisible again.

If ENV-07's NO_GATE_MUTATION binding were dropped from STAGE_A_CONSUMPTION, the authority would over-require the three-surface proof before Stage-A. Dropping it must produce a detectable gate enlargement, and the certifier must verify the authority does not currently commit it.

If the amendment were removed from CONTROLLING_AUTHORITY and only the ledger's DGR-06 frozen correction were consulted, the authority would state the destroy-and-reprovision rule using a definition of a target holding data that the amendment has already superseded. Removing the amendment must therefore change what the rollback clause asserts.

If the D1 absence re-derivation were replaced by the ledger's frozen measured_at_base counts, the authority would carry a count frozen against a different tree. Substituting the frozen count for the re-derivation must be detectable, since the method statement would no longer name a measurement taken at AS_OF_TREE.

If PRI-7's explicit out-of-scope declaration for storage object bytes were removed, a green RESTORE_PROOF would read as covering storage, which a PostgreSQL logical dump cannot do. Removal must make the ENV-07.1 three-surface gap invisible to a future reader.

If the fail-closed data posture in DATA_PROTECTION_IN_A_REHEARSAL_RESTORE were inverted to assume staging holds only laboratory fixture data, the rehearsal would proceed without customer-data protections while the instrument that could justify that assumption, a CLASSIFICATION_RUN, does not exist. Inverting it must be detectable as an unproven permissive assumption.

If OF-6 and the blocking owner decisions were removed, final_state would silently become AUTHORED_NOT_EXECUTED and the pair would appear ready for certification with no owner input. Removal must therefore change final_state, and a certifier must confirm the two travel together.

If MG-4 were deleted, adjudication E's third ground would read as a measured provider property rather than as an inference from an observed CLI surface. Deletion must therefore remove the qualification that OF-3 exists to flag.
